name: new_page_template_s_picture_only
arch:
<data inherit_id="website.new_page_template_s_picture_only">
    <!-- Remove shape option -->
    <xpath expr="//section" position="attributes">
        <attribute name="data-oe-shape-data"/>
    </xpath>
    <!-- Remove shape -->
    <xpath expr="//div[hasclass('o_we_shape')]" position="replace"/>
</data>
